units.summary: No data owner roles are defined.

The data inventory assigns Operations Director as owner for WMS data, TMS shipment data and the TMS document log; it assigns other datasets to roles such as the Customer Service Team Lead and HR manager.
The company has no central data warehouse, and reporting relies on manual Excel exports prepared by the IT Manager.
units.quote: There is no central data warehouse.

units.summary: Customer master data is maintained separately in the WMS, TMS and Business Central, without a shared customer identifier.
units.quote: Customer master data is maintained separately in the WMS, TMS and Business Central, and there is no shared customer identifier between the systems.

units.summary: The WMS data is available from the 2020 upgrade, while older data is not directly comparable because the database structure changed.
units.quote: We upgraded it in 2020 and the database structure changed, so older data is not directly comparable.

units.summary: The WMS is an on-premise SQL Server system, and the IT Manager has read-only SQL access.
The TMS offers a REST API for single records; bulk export is a paid service.
units.quote: REST API, single records; bulk export as paid service

units.summary: For paper documents, the TMS document log records the scan date as the registration date.
units.quote: Registration date = scan date for paper documents

units.topic: freight document archive quality and indexing
units.summary: The scanned archive contains image-only PDFs with no text layer; it has no index, and its file names are inconsistent.
Weekly customer volume forecasts are available from about 12 customers, arrive irregularly as differently formatted Excel attachments, and are often missing.
units.quote: Different formats per customer; often missing

units.summary: The shared mailbox contains consumer personal data, and categories are not stored in the email dataset.
units.quote: Personal data of consumers; no categories stored

units.summary: The company has no written policy on the use of generative AI tools, while several customer contracts restrict transfers of customer data outside the EU/EEA.
units.quote: The company has no written policy on the use of generative AI tools.

units.summary: The operations director estimated that the company handles around 1,200 freight documents a day across all sites.
units.quote: My feeling is around 1200 a day, all sites together.

units.summary: A second estimate put the volume at around 1,000 documents on a normal working day according to the TMS log; the log counts paper documents when scanned.
units.quote: I would say it's a bit less, maybe around a thousand on a normal working day according to the TMS document log. But the log only counts paper documents when they are scanned, so it depends on how you count.

units.topic: planned data collection for document pilot
units.summary: The company agreed to provide about 200 anonymized freight documents spanning types, sites and languages, including at least 50 with handwritten remarks, and, if possible, the clerks’ corresponding entries.
units.quote: For the document pilot, a sample of about 200 real documents, anonymized, a mix of types, sites, and languages, and at least 50 with handwritten remarks.

units.topic: planned data collection for forecasting and document analysis
units.summary: The planned data extract includes daily WMS volumes per site since 2020 and the TMS document log for 2025.
units.quote:
[ ] Jari: export daily WMS volumes per site 2020-2026 and the TMS document log for 2025 - by
    30 October 2026.

conflicts.description: The meeting notes state that no data owner roles are defined (unit 1), whereas the data inventory includes data-owner assignments, such as Operations Director (unit 2). The instructions specify no source priority, so the difference is unresolved.

One estimate is around 1,200 documents per day across all sites (unit 13); another is around 1,000 on a normal working day based on the TMS log, with the caveat that paper documents are counted when scanned (unit 14). No source hierarchy resolves the differing estimates.
